research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Ericsson is researching wireless communication, extended reality audio, cloud data processing, AI integration and security. Work on generating reverberation for connected spaces in an extended reality scene, rendering of audio elements, deriving parameters for use in audio rendering and audio rendering of audio sources targets realistic spatial sound, including efficient head-related filter generation, comfort noise generation for multi-mode spatial audio coding and low-rate noise shaping vector quantizer for audio coding. These efforts span immersive media, advanced networks and secure cloud workflows.

about_short_description.short_description: Ericsson is an information and communications technology company that offers network services.

product.name: Ericsson Radio System
product.description: A radio access network portfolio for deploying and managing cellular connectivity across 4G and 5G environments, including radio, antenna and baseband capabilities.

product.name: Ericsson Cloud RAN
product.description: A cloud-native radio access network solution that runs RAN functions as software on standardized cloud infrastructure for more flexible, automated deployments.

product.name: 5G Core
product.description: A cloud-native mobile core network platform that manages subscriber access, policy, mobility, charging, network slicing and service exposure for 5G networks.

product.name: OSS/BSS Solutions
product.description: Operations and business support software for planning, provisioning, monitoring, monetizing and managing communications services and network resources.

product.name: Network Management and Automation
product.description: Software for configuring, orchestrating, monitoring and optimizing telecom networks, using automation and AI to improve performance, efficiency and operational control.

product.name: 5G Transport
product.description: Transport network solutions that connect radio access, core and cloud environments, carrying mobile traffic with required capacity, latency, synchronization and reliability.
